profile.legal_name: Allen Edwin Residential Builders LLC (doing business as Allen Edwin Homes)

regions.name: Indiana / SW Michigan
regions.geography: Northern Indiana, Fort Wayne, Southwest Michigan

profile.org_note: Founder-led private builder run from a single corporate office in Portage, MI. There are no division presidents: land, finance, legal, sales and operations are centralised under a handful of vice presidents reporting to CEO Scott Sanderson, and the field is split into four production regions run by regional construction/production managers (listed here as the region leaders; they are construction managers, not P&L division heads). Land decisions sit with the VP of Land Development and the CEO; the Workforce Housing unit (Brian Farkas) sources municipal and infill land using Michigan housing TIF and PILOT incentives. The company website names only sales, support and production staff; the vice-president layer comes from the BBB profile and an unverified third-party org chart.
profile.summary: Conventional private for-sale builder (entry-level and move-up, about 1,000 closings a year) based in Portage, MI, calling itself Michigan's largest home builder: 100+ active communities across Michigan, northern Indiana and northwest Ohio, many in small towns, with 150+ move-in-ready spec homes on offer. It also has a build-to-lease brand, Copper Bay, and a Workforce Housing unit that builds for-sale and rental homes on municipal and infill land with Michigan housing TIF/PILOT support (pledge of 2,500 extra homes over 10 years). It buys land directly from owners and cities (0.25 to 100 acres) and develops it in-house; a plausible but small-ticket land-banking customer, with many scattered positions rather than large master-planned takedowns.
